The United States workshop card permits only A/B/D/F/G. The Russian Federation workshop card permits only C/E. The public rule and delivered evidence establish no common package. The chair should refer the choices for further workshop discussion. This workshop recommendation has no official authority.
S/2019/186 records “It received nine votes in favour, three against and three abstentions. China and the Russian Federation voted against it as permanent members, and the draft was not adopted.” S/2019/190 records “It received four votes in favour, seven against and four abstentions and failed to reach the required number of affirmative votes.”

Workshop status: F
The Japan workshop card permits only A/D/F. The China workshop card permits only B/F/G. Both delivered cards permit package F. The chair should recommend it. This workshop recommendation has no official authority.
S/2024/323 records “It received 7 votes for, 7 against and 1 abstention and failed to reach the required affirmative votes.” S/2024/302 records “The draft had 13 votes for, 1 against and 1 abstention. It was not adopted due to the negative vote of a permanent member.”
